name: fdms-offline-build
description: FALLBACK location for the ES5 build toolchain of tools/build_offline.py. Round 23 (28/08/2026) dropped the export's floor to Firefox 32 and compiles every inline script to pure ES5; esbuild cannot do that (it bottoms out at ES2015 and refuses --target=es5), so @babel/preset-env transpiles and acorn proves the result by parsing it at ecmaVersion 5. The builder looks for these in $FDMS_BUILD_DEPS, then in D:/FDMS-build-deps, then here — the recorded home is OUTSIDE the repository so the public repo never carries ~30 MB of node_modules. Versions are pinned EXACTLY; build_offline.py hard-fails on drift. tools/node_modules is gitignored.
